Text.Page:
[EN]
It was a cold night. The holiday is normally filled with joy and happiness. But that day was different.

I couldn't help thinking that something wasn't right. And then, suddenly, Mutated Poporis were swarming our farm. The grownups went out and fought. My sister and I were too afraid to help, so we stayed inside.

The villagers didn't stand a chance. There were too many of them. Soon, the mutants got inside the house.Read the next page.
[ES]
Era una noche fría. La festividad normalmente se llena de alegría y felicidad. Pero ese día fue diferente.

No podía evitar pensar que algo no iba bien. Y entonces, de repente, Poporis mutados invadieron nuestra granja. Los adultos salieron a luchar. Mi hermana y yo teníamos demasiado miedo para ayudar, así que nos quedamos dentro.

Los aldeanos no tuvieron ninguna oportunidad. Eran demasiados. Pronto, los mutantes entraron en la casa.Read the next page.

[EN]
I couldn't move. My sister had to grab my hand and drag me to the back door.
She threw me out the door and told me "Run! Don't look back!"

I did what she said. I didn't look back. I just ran.
But the mutants kept chasing me. I don't remember how long I kept running. I was getting tired and the mutants were getting closer.Read the next page.
[ES]
No podía moverme. Mi hermana tuvo que agarrarme de la mano y arrastrarme hacia la puerta trasera.
Me arrojó fuera de la puerta y me dijo: "¡Corre! ¡No mires atrás!"

Hice lo que dijo. No miré atrás. Simplemente corrí.
Pero los mutantes seguían persiguiéndome. No recuerdo cuánto tiempo seguí corriendo. Me estaba cansando y los mutantes se acercaban cada vez más.Read the next page.

[EN] Then, just as my legs gave out, it seemed as though the moonlight... shimmered. Almost as though the moon had shattered into pieces. But it wasn't the moon.

A mutant fell down beside me, and before I knew it, they were all dead.

When I recovered my wits, I found a runeglaive, along with a letter, just lying on the ground.

"Just as the moonlight guided my path to you, I hope this runeglaive will help you."

As soon as I read the letter, I knew what I had to do. I grabbed the runeglaive and headed back.
Back to Popolion.
(The next page is torn out.)

Quoted from [Valkyrie Journal], author unknownClose the book.
[ES] Entonces, justo cuando mis piernas fallaron, pareció como si la luz de la luna... parpadeara. Casi como si la luna se hubiera hecho añicos. Pero no era la luna.

Un mutante cayó a mi lado y, antes de que me diera cuenta, todos estaban muertos.

Cuando recuperé la compostura, encontré un runeglaive, junto con una carta, tirados en el suelo.

"Así como la luz de la luna guió mi camino hacia ti, espero que este runeglaive te ayude".

Tan pronto como leí la carta, supe lo que tenía que hacer. Agarré el runeglaive y regresé.
De vuelta a Popolion.
